sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Add boosters
Adds 1,000 of each booster every time the game starts. A booster is usable from its usual level, or from the first level with Unlock booster slots. Requires a standard install.
Add extra moves
Starts every level with five extra moves. Requires a standard install.
Disable events
Turns off limited-time events such as races, quests and leagues.
Disable notifications
Stops game reminders and the notification permission prompt. Requires a standard install.
Disable tracking

Stops AppsFlyer, Braze, Firebase Analytics and Google measurement from collecting data, and removes the advertising ID and install referrer permissions. Braze push and in-app messages stop too. Requires a standard install.
Hide ads
Stops ad networks from starting and blocks rewarded and interstitial ads.
Parked app for Android Auto
Lists the game on the Android Auto car screen while parked. Requires Android 15 or newer and a standard install. Android Auto needs Unknown sources turned on in its developer settings.
Remove ad offers
Removes offers to watch an ad for extra moves, lives or boosters.
Remove offer pop-ups
Removes pop-ups selling bundles, passes and limited-time offers.
Remove rating prompts
Removes prompts asking to rate the game after a level.
Unlimited lives
Adds 24 hours of unlimited lives every time the game starts. Requires a standard install.
Unlock booster slots
Unlocks all booster slots from the first level. Requires a standard install.
